pricing.title: Free to start. Fair when you grow.
pricing.lead: Search and reaction suggestions are on every plan. Pay for volume, photos, custom emoji and team features.

what.a: One platform for everything emoji in your product: search that understands people in 11 languages, reaction suggestions, photo to emoji, custom emoji, hosted emoji sets, analytics and per-customer emoji for platforms. It plugs into the app and the picker you already have.

server.a: No. The engine and dictionary run in the browser or app. The hosted API adds meaning search for unusual queries; you can also self-host it on your own Cloudflare account.

pickers.a: React and the Frimousse picker today, plus a web component for Vue, Svelte, Angular and plain HTML, editor extensions for Tiptap and Lexical, a Swift SDK, a Chrome extension, Raycast and an MCP server for AI apps.

limit.q: What happens when I reach my plan limit?
limit.a: Nothing breaks for your users. Popular searches still get smart answers, and the on-device dictionary covers everything else until the next month.

where.a: The engine runs on your users' devices. The API runs on Cloudflare's network in 300+ cities, so every search is answered close to the person typing it. There is no single region to be far from.

privacy.q: What do you know about my users?
privacy.a: Nothing personal. We never store who searched, from which app, or what they wrote in a message. Your usage and analytics stay in your account.

openSource.a: Yes. The engine, SDKs, data pack and API server are MIT. The hosted service adds daily dictionary updates, analytics and custom emoji.

final.title: Emoji, solved. Everywhere.
final.text: Give your users emoji that just work — in every language, on every device. Free to start, ready in minutes.

network.title: The more people search, the smarter it gets.

device.title: On the device

calls.title: What counts as a call?
calls.lead: Most emoji searches never reach our servers. The device and ready-made answers handle them, free and unlimited on every plan. A call is counted only when the edge AI does the work.

device.title: On the device
device.body: Names, slang, typos and {languages} languages, from the dictionary inside your app. Works offline.

ready.title: Ready-made answers
ready.body: Popular searches are answered ahead of time and served as plain files, close to your users.

edge.title: Edge AI
edge.body: Brand-new phrasing and reaction suggestions go to the edge API, which understands them by meaning.

calls.title: AI calls
calls.body: A meaning search or a reaction suggestion that reaches the edge API. One request, one call.

photos.title: Photos
photos.body: Each photo turned into emoji. Photos are processed in memory and never stored.

free.failed: Requests that fail on our side

calls.foot: No errors and no broken pickers. The API answers with overLimit: true, and the SDK switches to the device on its own. Limits reset monthly (UTC), with no daily caps.

oss.title: Prefer to run it yourself?
oss.body: The core of Emojisense is MIT. Run it on your own Cloudflare account with no license fee, and pay Cloudflare directly. Hosted plans add daily dictionary updates, analytics, hosted emoji sets and zero operations.

custom.title: Need more than {plan}?
custom.body: Higher limits, many tenants, or a setup that does not fit a plan? Tell us what you are building.

free.q: Is the free plan really free?
free.a: Yes, and you need no card. It includes {calls} AI calls and {photos} photo classifications a month, every SDK and integration, and unlimited on-device answers. There is no “powered by” badge on any plan.

call.a: A meaning search or a reaction suggestion that reaches our edge API. Answers from the device and ready-made answers for popular searches are free and unlimited. Photo to emoji has its own monthly count.
call.link: See how a search is answered

limit.q: What happens when I reach a limit?
limit.a: Nothing breaks for your users. The API keeps answering with overLimit: true, and the SDK switches to the on-device dictionary and ready-made answers on its own. Cached answers are still served. New AI calls and photos resume on the 1st of the next month.

failed.q: Do you count requests that fail?
failed.a: No. If our AI cannot answer, your users still get results from the dictionary, and the request is not counted.

reset.a: On the first day of each month, UTC. There are no daily caps.

yearly.none: Not yet. Every plan bills monthly for now.

billing.a: Choose a plan on this page, then sign in to the dashboard and pay on Whop's checkout. Whop is our payment provider: it takes the card or another local payment method and sends the receipts. The plan changes for all your apps as soon as the payment goes through.

cancel.q: Can I cancel or change my plan?
cancel.a: Yes, at any time. In the dashboard, Billing → Manage subscription opens Whop, where you cancel. You keep the plan until the end of the period you paid for; then the account moves to Free, and your apps keep working within the Free limits. To change plans, choose another one on the Billing page: the new plan starts when it is paid, and the old one stops renewing. Whop does not prorate.

paymentFailed.a: Whop tries the charge again and emails you. Your plan keeps working for {days} days. Update the payment method in Billing → Manage subscription; if no payment goes through by then, the account moves to Free.

refunds.a: [Refund policy: to be decided before launch.] Until it is published, write to [support email] about any payment.

selfHost.a: Yes. The engine, SDKs, data pack, API server and dashboard are MIT. Run them on your own Cloudflare account and pay Cloudflare directly. The open data pack is updated every quarter; hosted plans get daily dictionary updates.

store.q: What do you store about my users?
store.a: Nothing personal. We never store who searched, IP addresses, message text or images. Photos are processed in memory.

final.title: Start free. Grow when you are ready.
final.text: Get a key in a minute and keep the free plan as long as it fits.

hero.title: Emoji, the way people mean them.
hero.lead: Emojisense is the complete emoji platform for every app: search, reactions, photo to emoji, custom emoji and more, in every language.

why.title: Why it exists
why.body: Most emoji pickers match the official names of emoji. People do not type names. They type a film, a feeling, an idiom or a typo, and a name search finds nothing. We built the search that understands them, and then everything else a product needs around emoji.

how.title: How it works
how.body: A small dictionary runs on the device and answers most searches in under a millisecond. Common searches have ready-made answers in static files. Only the unusual ones go to our API on Cloudflare's network, which finds emoji by meaning and answers close to the person typing.

neverBreaks.title: It never breaks
neverBreaks.text: Over a plan limit, search keeps working on the device. Your users never see an error because of a bill.

private.title: Private by design
private.text: Most searches never leave the device. We never store who searched, message text or photos.

open.title: Open at the core
open.text: The engine, data packs, SDKs and API server are MIT. Run them yourself if you like.

languages.title: Every language
languages.text: People search in their own words and their own language, so the dictionary does too.

money.title: How we make money
money.body: Search and reaction suggestions are free on every plan. Paid plans add volume, photo to emoji, custom emoji, analytics, teams and tenants. No ads, and we do not sell data. <pricing>Choose a plan</pricing>, or <free>start free</free> today.
